race.title: Royal British Legion Poppy Appeal 2026 Handicap Chase
race.verdict: GAMBIE TIEP is potentially thrown-in on old form so is well worth another chance after a considerate stable debut following a long absence. Likely front runner Applejack Poet is feared most. GAMBIE TIEP (FR) APPLEJACK POET (IRE) BELLE MONTROSE (IRE)
